subsystems.name: Swerve Drivetrain
subsystems.summary: Four SDS MK4n assemblies identified in the CAD. Drive specifications await confirmation.

subsystems.name: Electronics

subsystems.name: Arthritis — Intake
subsystems.summary: Collects FUEL from the field. Actual four-bar and pin-slot linkage; 0° is confirmed deployed, 74° is an estimated stowed limit. Roller speeds and feed forces are demo values.

subsystems.name: a thunk a thunk — Dye Rotor / Indexer
subsystems.summary: Original V2 cylindrical guide and bolted carrier rotate with the 42T SplineXL shaft at 12:42 reduction. Chain and output shafts animate while feeding; external motor and mounts stay fixed. Internal roller spin and FUEL contact forces remain uncalibrated.

subsystems.name: Ptooey — Shooter
subsystems.summary: Single M–U FUEL exit. Turret and camera rotate together; the adjustable hood follows the main flywheel shaft. Aiming table, speeds and travel limits remain uncalibrated.

subsystems.name: Frame & Structure
subsystems.summary: Remaining structural components and unmatched CAD parts.
